```{r message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(pctax)
library(pcutils)
library(gt)
```

# mitochondria

```{r echo=FALSE}
blast.tb <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/metaMDBG/fcs-gx/minimap2/rasusa/hifiasm/fcs-gx/rag_tag/blast',
                       pattern = '.mito.tsv', full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map_dfr(function(file) {
    read.table(file, colClasses = c('character')) |> mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(file), '.mito.tsv'))
  })
blast <- data.frame(sample = blast.tb$sample,
                    seqid = blast.tb$V1,
                    pident = blast.tb$V3, # percentage identity
                    align.length = blast.tb$V4, # alignment length
                    query.length = blast.tb$V5,
                    subject.length = blast.tb$V6,
                    e.value = blast.tb$V7)

blast |> 
  filter(str_detect(seqid, 'RagTag')) |> 
  group_by(sample) |> 
  gt() 
```

# BLAST nt/nr

```{r echo=FALSE}
blast.tb <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/metaMDBG/fcs-gx/minimap2/rasusa/hifiasm/fcs-gx/rag_tag/blast',
                       pattern = '.nt.tsv', full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map_dfr(function(file) {
    read.table(file, colClasses = c('character')) |> mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(file), '.nt.tsv'))
  })
blast <- data.frame(sample = blast.tb$sample,
                    seqid = blast.tb$V1,
                    pident = blast.tb$V3, # percentage identity
                    align.length = blast.tb$V4, # alignment length
                    query.length = blast.tb$V5,
                    subject.length = blast.tb$V6,
                    e.value = blast.tb$V7,
                    name_or_id2df(blast.tb$V8,mode = 'id',fill_miss_rank = FALSE,add_prefix = FALSE) |> select(Phylum, Species))

blast |> 
  filter(str_detect(seqid, 'RagTag')) |> 
  group_by(sample, seqid) |> 
  gt() 
```
